### `PD-031` — Iranian Payroll Statutory Source Activation Policy

**Domain:** Payroll / Regulatory  
**Accepted option / disposition:** Promoted from DTR-PD-011 — Option B  
**V1 position:** BLOCKS PRODUCTION / IRAN MARKET PAYROLL  
**Status:** `FROZEN`

**Decision statement:** Iranian statutory rules use governed versioned/effective-dated source packages with official Tax/Labor/Social Security authority, classification/bases/caps/shares/YTD/rounding/retroactivity/schema/review/evidence. Production/market activation is fail-closed pending current authoritative evidence and required sign-off.

**Production / evidence boundary:** DTR-GAP-045 current statutory correctness remains UNABLE TO VERIFY.

**Source provenance:** `DTR-PD-011`  
**Affected Integration / governing links:** —  
**Affected PDM:** DTR-PDM-005  
**Affected Journeys:** —

**Guardrail / fail-closed rule:** Approval of governance policy ≠ validation of current statutory values

# BONIRA — Payroll Statutory Source Package Specification

Governed by `PD-031`.

Every activated statutory package must be versioned/effective-dated and tied to official Tax/Labor/Social Security authority, component classification, taxable/insurable bases, caps/exemptions/shares, YTD treatment, rounding, retroactivity, schema version, review/approval and evidence.

No current Iranian rate/cap/threshold/value is supplied here.

`NO OFFICIAL STATUTORY EVIDENCE → DO NOT INVENT CURRENT VALUE`

Current statutory values/evidence remain UTV.
